children: Genius Foundation currently holds about 142,860 BNC shares, representing roughly 0.347% of the company and making it the 15th-largest shareholder. According to Odaily, Genius said its community has continued accumulating the stock through Genius.fun.

The group previously said it held about 70,000 shares on September 18, equal to about 0.17% of the float. It said holdings rose to 135,000 shares by September 21 and have now increased further to about 142,860 shares.

title: Genius Foundation Holds About 142,860 BNC Shares, Ranking as 15th-Largest Shareholder
